info.title: Syvon API
info.description: Two client-facing surfaces: the Portal management plane (syvon.ai/api/*, portal JWT) and the Brain read plane (brain.syvon.ai/v1/*, workspace key sk_ws_…). Schemas are generated from the @syvon/sdk TypeScript types — the shipped .d.ts files are the authoritative contract.

post.description: From a signed-in session (magic link / Google / Apple cookie). The JWT is user-scoped and lives ~1 hour; refresh via POST /api/auth/refresh.

post.summary: Create and activate an empty workspace
post.description: Plan-gated: returns 402 over the plan limit.

200.description: The new workspace (includes its R2 prefix)

patch.summary: Update workspace name/slug/settings (owner or admin only)

delete.summary: PERMANENTLY delete a workspace and all of its R2 content

post.summary: Set a workspace as the caller's active workspace

get.summary: API key metadata for the workspace (raw keys are never returned)

post.summary: Mint a workspace API key (owner/admin + multi-workspace plan)
post.description: Returns the raw sk_ws_… key ONCE. 402 with code API_KEYS_NOT_AVAILABLE on a single-workspace plan.

200.description: The minted key (raw key shown once)

402.description: API keys not available on this plan

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by refType (render, voice, llm, topup, …)

get.summary: The workspace's file index (workspace-relative R2 keys)

200.description: Which workspace and key this is

get.description: agentId is a Project id in the key's workspace. Slugs are not accepted. 404 for an unknown id or an agent outside the workspace.

get.summary: The published presentation config (layout, greeting, theme)
get.description: Unpublished agents return neutral defaults. The parser never throws.

get.summary: The published brand-site config (sitemap, nav, sections)
get.description: An empty pages array means "no site published".

get.summary: The frozen workspace file index for the release
Published feed posts (newest first, up to 120)
Stream a raw workspace R2 object
get.description: Workspace-relative key. Only allowlisted prefixes (brands/, projects/, workflows/, …) are reachable; others 403. Pipe the body; do not buffer large objects.

post.description: One JSON event per line; assemble the reply from event.text. The agent owner is billed for the turn. Pass a salted client hash for per-visitor rate limiting (never a raw IP). 429 when rate limited.

200.description: NDJSON stream of ChatStreamEvent, one per line

workspaceId.description: The user's currently-active workspace id, if any.

logoKey.description: Workspace-relative r2 key of the default brand's logo, if any.

wrapConfig.description: Partial merge — only a whitelisted set of keys is accepted.

key.description: The raw key. Returned ONCE at mint time — capture or lose it.

r2Key.description: Agent-scoped r2 key (relative to the project's storagePrefix).

key.description: Agent-scoped r2 key of the cover/primary media.

playable.description: MP4/webm key when a transcode exists.

client.description: Salty hash identifying the visitor (for per-visitor rate limiting).

threadKey.description: Conversation thread id (resumes a thread server-side).

section.description: A page/section id the wrapper scopes the answer to.

ChatStreamEvent.description: A single line from the NDJSON chat stream. Discriminated by `type`.

content.description: Full accumulated text on completion (some events).
